scope: Provider-status classification for release evidence; not hosted product or customer-journey proof

observedProviderEvidence.description: No deployment needed - watched paths not modified

rootCause: Provider commit statuses expose successful path-filter handling through the same state field used for executed deployments. The repository policy rejected status-only green, but the executable blocker classifier lacked the exact skip-success signature.

repair.behaviour: Explicit provider skip-success receipts are promotion-blocking, development may continue, fallback execution is allowed, and the receipt states countsAsProof=false and executedEvidence=false. All other blocker classifications also state these evidence fields explicitly.

releaseGate.before: BLOCKED: provider state=success required manual interpretation to distinguish a skipped deployment
releaseGate.afterSourceRepair: BUILT: the existing executable blocker classifier now rejects the exact observed skip-success receipt
releaseGate.promotion: BLOCKED until an admitted exact candidate produces executed, source-bound terminal proof and the hosted durability/Golden Journey/Cold Witness gates pass

nextProof: Run the exact classifier and admitted proof lane under Node v22.23.2 on a deliberate freeze-trigger candidate; verify provider skip-success cannot satisfy promotion and terminal execution artifacts bind to the exact source SHA.
